segments.title: Q turret damage and the call for more armour
segments.summary: A Q turret incident prompts a call for more armour after a ship-design discussion about budget competition between the Kaiserliche Marine and the German Army.
segments.body: In the opening ship-design discussion, the proposed budget fight pits the Kaiserliche Marine against the German Army. The navy is expected to lose that contest. The Q turret incident then draws a startled reaction: spectacular, but unwelcome. The immediate recommendation is to put more armour on the turrets in future. A closing remark expresses surprise at the ship's apparent survival.

evidence.note: The opening frames the scenario as a budget fight involving the German navy and the German Army.
The reaction recommends more turret armour, followed by surprise at apparent survival. The transcript does not establish the mechanism of damage or clearly identify the ship.
